meta_description:
14K likes, 1,082 comments - pamela_rf on October 25, 2026: "ad 🎈CHOCOLATE CHIPS ARE BACK!!! 🍪 The re-launch so many wished for 🫡 2 years ago, we had to discontinue them due to the increasing cacao prices (especially because I use Fairtrade + organic cacao). But now things are possible again!

I thought nobody will care if they go out of the range, simply because they are no rocket science 😅 BUT YOU GUYS NEVER FORGOT ABOUT THEM. And I agree, baking ist just not the same anymore👩🏼‍🍳

🫱🏼‍🫲🏽 The most simple thing ever: Just 3 ingredients, no bullsh*t & less sugar than comparable chocolate chips.

My very 1st @naturally_pam product 🥹 without the Chocolate Chips, my brand wouldn’t even exist. 

- 45% less carbs than comparable chocolate chips 
- Fairtrade cacao 
- organic, gluten free, vegan
- 70% cacao = dark chocolate 
- no additives, just the 3 necessary ingredients 
- coconut sugar, instead of cane sugar
- high fiber 
- NOTHING HAS CHANGED. Same product, same ingredients, same behavior during baking. Just the packaging 🥰

📱Need inspo on how to use them? 🍪Search for „Chocolate Chips“ in your Pam App & find soooo many cake, cookie & snack recipes.".
